notes_for_llms: Prefer faasr_get_file when the function needs to read an input artifact from S3 into local disk.
Prefer faasr_put_file when the function produced a local artifact and needs to persist it back to S3.
Use faasr_get_folder_list to discover available objects/prefixes before deciding which file(s) to download.
Use faasr_delete_file to clean up outputs or remove stale artifacts in S3.
Use faasr_log for debug/status messages; logs go to DefaultDataStore unless overridden by LoggingDataStore.
Use faasr_rank only in workflows that trigger concurrent executions using rank.
Use faasr_invocation_id when you need a unique identifier for the current action invocation (e.g., tagging logs/outputs).

functions.name: faasr_get_file
functions.summary: Download a file from an S3 bucket to the local filesystem for use by the FaaSr function.

parameters.name: server_name
parameters.description: S3 bucket/datastore name declared in the workflow configuration JSON. If omitted, uses DefaultDataStore.

parameters.name: remote_folder
parameters.description: Remote folder/prefix in the S3 bucket to download from.

parameters.name: remote_file
parameters.description: Name of the file to download from the S3 bucket.

parameters.name: local_folder
parameters.description: Local folder where the downloaded file will be stored.

parameters.name: local_file
parameters.description: Local filename for the downloaded object.

returns.description: Downloads the file; no return value specified in the documentation.

side_effects: Writes a local file to local_folder/local_file

when_to_use: Need to load an input artifact from S3 into the function runtime
Preparing local data for processing (CSV, JSON, model files, etc.)
common_pitfalls: remote_file and local_file are required; remote_folder/local_folder have defaults
server_name must match a datastore name declared in workflow configuration

functions.name: faasr_put_file
functions.summary: Upload a local file from the FaaSr function runtime to an S3 bucket.

parameters.name: server_name
parameters.description: S3 bucket/datastore name declared in the workflow configuration JSON. If omitted, uses DefaultDataStore.

parameters.name: local_folder
parameters.description: Local folder where the file to upload is located.

parameters.name: remote_folder
parameters.description: Remote folder/prefix in the S3 bucket to upload into.

parameters.name: remote_file
parameters.description: Remote filename for the uploaded object.

returns.description: Uploads the file; no return value specified in the documentation.

side_effects: Reads a local file from local_folder/local_file
Writes to S3 bucket at remote_folder/remote_file

when_to_use: Need to persist function outputs (CSV, figures, logs, model artifacts) back to S3
Export intermediate artifacts for downstream workflow steps
common_pitfalls: server_name must match a datastore name declared in workflow configuration

functions.name: faasr_get_folder_list
functions.summary: List the contents of a folder/prefix in the S3 bucket.

parameters.name: server_name
parameters.description: S3 bucket/datastore name declared in the workflow configuration JSON. If omitted, uses DefaultDataStore.

parameters.name: faasr_prefix
parameters.description: Prefix representing the folder path in the S3 bucket.

returns.description: A list with the contents of the specified S3 prefix/folder.

side_effects: Reads object metadata/listing from S3 bucket

when_to_use: Need to discover which files exist before downloading
Need to iterate over many files in a prefix
Need to validate outputs exist after a workflow step
common_pitfalls: faasr_prefix defaults to empty string, which may list the bucket root/prefix

functions.name: faasr_delete_file
functions.summary: Delete a file from the S3 bucket.

parameters.name: server_name
parameters.description: S3 bucket/datastore name declared in the workflow configuration JSON. If omitted, uses DefaultDataStore.

parameters.name: remote_folder
parameters.description: Remote folder/prefix in the S3 bucket to delete from.

parameters.name: remote_file
parameters.description: Remote filename of the object to delete.

returns.description: Deletes the file; no return value specified in the documentation.

side_effects: Removes an object from S3 bucket at remote_folder/remote_file

when_to_use: Need to remove stale or temporary artifacts from S3
Cleanup step after validation or retries
common_pitfalls: Be careful with remote_folder default "" to avoid deleting an unintended object name

functions.name: faasr_log
functions.summary: Write a log message to a file in the S3 bucket to aid debugging.

parameters.name: log_message
parameters.description: Message to be written to the log.

defaults_and_resolution.log_datastore: DefaultDataStore unless overridden by LoggingDataStore (workflow config)

returns.description: Writes a log entry; no return value specified in the documentation.

side_effects: Appends/writes a log message to a log file stored in S3 (datastore depends on config)

examples.code:
log_msg = f"Function compute_sum finished; output written to {folder}/{output} in default S3 bucket"
faasr_log(log_msg)

when_to_use: Need to record progress, debugging info, or key variables in long pipelines
Need persistent logs across ephemeral function invocations
common_pitfalls: Logging location is determined by workflow configuration (DefaultDataStore/LoggingDataStore)

functions.name: faasr_rank
functions.summary: Return the rank metadata for concurrent rank-based workflow invocations.
functions.applicability: Only for workflows where functions are triggered for concurrent execution using rank.

returns.description: Dictionary with keys max_rank and rank.

examples.code:
rank_list = faasr_rank()
my_rank = rank_list["rank"]
max_rank = rank_list["max_rank"]
local_file = f"myinput_{my_rank}.csv"
df.to_csv(local_file, index=False)

when_to_use: Need to shard work across N concurrent invocations
Need rank-indexed file naming (e.g., myoutput_1.csv ... myoutput_N.csv)
common_pitfalls: Do not call in non-rank workflows unless you know rank-based triggering is enabled

functions.name: faasr_invocation_id
functions.summary: Return the current action's invocation ID.

returns.description: A unique identifier for this action invocation.

when_to_use: Need a unique ID to tag outputs, logs, or trace execution
Need correlation across steps for debugging
